jobs.description: Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for hands-on and detail-oriented professionals who want to join our team as Loss Prevention Expert. In this key role, you will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss. Key job responsibilities • Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility • Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards • Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local management and external stakeholder (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters • Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards • Own Security and Loss Prevention-related projects on the local, regional, and country level A day in the life As a Loss Prevention Expert, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in our processes and you identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our Security and Loss Prevention plan. About the team Sitting within the Global Security Operations organization, Security and Loss Prevention supports the accomplishment of Amazon´s business targets and the strengthening of our brand by effectively protecting against relevant threats and by managing security and loss prevention risks that could: • Put our associates and customers under jeopardy • Disrupt the continuity of our business operations • Inflict damage to our assets • Have adverse impact on our brand reputation Working in partnership with our stakeholders, we secure the Amazon supply chain end-to-end and promote security during business conversations. We do this by preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize any negative impact as well as thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, preventing re-occurrence.

jobs.description: Amazon Leo is bringing satellite internet to 100+ countries — and before we can sell in any of them, an enormous amount of behind-the-scenes checking has to pass: is every customer charged correctly, is tax right for that country's laws, does money move to the right accounts, are the invoices legally valid, does the whole buy-and-activate experience actually work end to end? Today, dozens of teams work through this by hand, one step after another, for months. It's the single biggest thing standing between "we're ready" and "we've launched" — and we're replacing that entire process with AI. Leo Regulus is an AI-native team building squads of autonomous agents that compress Leo's launch process from months to days. The agents run in parallel, share context across every domain a launch touches — tax, accounting, payments, legal, trade, and commerce — and get smarter with each country we ship. Crucially, we don't do the manual work; we build the agents that do it, and do it better each time. Instead of writing the checks by hand, we build agents that write, run, diagnose, and fix them. This is a rare kind of problem: real autonomy with real stakes — these agents gate a global product launch — and genuine cross-domain reasoning, because a single launch spans law, finance, payments, and the shopping experience all at once, and the agents have to keep each other in sync. You don't need any background in testing or launch operations; you need to be great at building intelligent systems and excited by agentic AI as the product itself — designing how agents plan, act, check their own work, recover from failure, and learn. If building the AI team that launches satellite internet across the planet — in minutes instead of months — sounds like the most interesting thing you could work on, let's talk. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities Key Job Responsibilities: *Design and build autonomous AI agents that execute end-to-end ecommerce validation without human intervention - Build orchestration systems that coordinate dozens of domain-specific agents working in parallel - Create knowledge base architectures that ground agent behavior in accounting, tax, and compliance rules - Solve novel problems at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and financial domain complexity A day in the life An SDE on Leo Regulus will be responsible for designing, building, and operating autonomous AI agent systems that automate the end-to-end ecommerce launch lifecycle — from requirements generation through financial configuration, test execution, and validation — enabling Amazon Leo to scale country and feature launches across 100+ markets without proportional headcount growth. About the team We are a team building the AI infrastructure that makes Amazon Leo's 100-country launch possible. Our entire stack is AI-native — every system we build either is an agent, powers an agent, or feeds an agent. We don't maintain legacy test frameworks or manual runbooks. We build autonomous systems and point them at problems that would otherwise require hundreds of engineers.

We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did we ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
Coupang’s Cyber Threat Intelligence team is part of GHOST within Proactive Security under the Digital Trust organization. GHOST stands for Global Hunting, Oversight, and Strategic Triage. The organization proactively identifies and analyzes cyber threats that may affect Coupang and turns its findings into meaningful security actions.
The Cyber Threat Intelligence team collects and analyzes information from a wide range of sources, including open sources, commercial intelligence services, the dark web, and security telemetry. The team tracks threat actors and campaigns and identifies and responds to threats that may affect Coupang, including phishing, fraud, brand and executive impersonation, exposed data and credentials, malicious infrastructure, and high-risk vulnerabilities.
This position will primarily focus on intelligence activities that protect Coupang executives. You will continuously monitor digital exposure, impersonation, personal information exposure, phishing, social engineering, and other online threats affecting executives. You will turn analytical findings into actionable intelligence that supports timely protective measures and informed decision-making.
The focus of this position is intelligence-led executive protection rather than physical close protection. However, because information discovered in the digital environment may indicate potential risks to physical safety, you will work closely with Corporate Security, Legal, Privacy, Investigations, and other relevant teams.
Executive protection will be the primary focus of this position. Depending on team priorities and the candidate’s expertise, the role may also contribute to other Cyber Threat Intelligence responsibilities, including Fraud Intelligence, Digital Risk Protection, and third-party and supply chain threat intelligence.
This position is being hired at the Staff level and requires at least eight years of professional experience in a relevant security field. We are looking for someone who can independently lead significant and sensitive threat investigations, coordinate response and program improvements across organizations, and translate intelligence into executive decisions and meaningful protective actions.
What You Will Do
Executive Digital Exposure Monitoring:
Monitor executive-related digital exposure across authorized sources, including the open web, social media, professional networking platforms, data leak sites, the deep web, and the dark web. Distinguish legitimate online activity from potential risk and identify exposures that require further action.
Executive Impersonation Detection and Response:
Detect and analyze social media and professional networking profiles, email accounts, domains, websites, messages, images, audio, video, and other synthetic media that impersonate executives. Assess the intent and potential impact of the impersonation and coordinate blocking, notification, takedown, and follow-up actions with relevant teams.
Personal Information and Credential Exposure Response:
Monitor for external exposure of sensitive executive information, including contact details, addresses, account information, credentials, schedules, or location-related information. Assess the accuracy and risk of exposed information and work with relevant teams and external service providers to support removal, takedown, account protection, and other protective actions.
Protective Intelligence and Threat Assessment:
Investigate phishing, social engineering, Business Email Compromise, malicious disclosure of personal information, harassment, threatening references, and indicators of cyber or physical targeting involving executives. Assess source credibility, threat actor intent and capability, likelihood, and potential impact, and recommend an appropriate response or escalation level.
Response Coordination and Case Management:
When an executive-related threat is identified, promptly share intelligence and coordinate response activities with Corporate Security, Legal, Privacy, Investigations, Incident Response, and other relevant teams. Document investigative evidence and response actions and track progress and residual risk until the case is closed.
Executive CTI Reporting:
Provide executives and relevant leadership with clear and concise reports and briefings on their individual threat environment, significant cyber threats, impersonation and personal information exposure, and risks requiring immediate attention. Communicate complex threat information in a form that non-technical audiences can understand and act upon.
Travel and Geopolitical Intelligence Support:
As needed, analyze geopolitical conditions, civil unrest, crime, terrorism, cyber threats, and other security risks related to executive travel or major events and provide relevant teams with intelligence briefings.
Support for Adjacent CTI Responsibilities:
Based on team priorities and operational needs, support other Cyber Threat Intelligence activities such as Fraud Intelligence, Digital Risk Protection, third-party and supply chain threat intelligence, phishing and brand protection, and data exposure investigations.
Tools, Automation, and AI:
Use CTI and Executive Protection platforms, search tools, data analysis technologies, and AI-powered tools to improve the efficiency and accuracy of monitoring, classification, enrichment, investigation, and reporting. Validate AI-generated outputs against original sources and additional investigation.
Global Collaboration:
Work effectively with security teams, executive support organizations, engineering teams, business stakeholders, external CTI providers, and takedown service providers across the United States, Korea, and other regions to mitigate threats affecting executives and Coupang.

jobs.description: Job Description Summary Nous recherchons un esprit analytique axé sur les processus, passionné par le succès des projets et déterminé à franchir la ligne d’arrivée. GE Vernova, à Laprairie, est un lieu où l’ingénierie complexe rencontre des résultats concrets. Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Spécialiste en gestion des commandes qui souhaite intégrer une équipe où chaque voix compte, où les idées d’amélioration des processus sont encouragées et où votre contribution devient le moteur de la réussite de nos projets. We are seeking a process-minded problem solver who loves seeing a project cross the finish line. GE Vernova, Laprairie is a place where complex engineering meets real-world results. We are looking for an Order Management Specialist who is looking for a team where your voice matters, your ideas for process improvement are encouraged, and your contributions are the heartbeat of our projects' successes. Job Description L’impact que vous aurez En tant que Spécialiste en gestion des commandes, vous êtes le maillon essentiel entre les équipes commerciales, nos gestionnaires de projets et l’équipe de planification. Vous ne vous contenterez pas de saisir des données ; vous serez l’architecte du flux de travail des projets. En garantissant l’exactitude dans SAP et en assurant la fluidité de notre documentation et de notre logistique, vous posez les bases de chaque jalon que nous atteignons. Au cours de vos six premiers mois, votre succès sera mesuré par votre capacité à respecter nos délais de livraison (internes et externes), à atteindre nos jalons de projet et à contribuer activement au suivi de la satisfaction client. Vous allez adorer travailler ici Nous valorisons les membres d’équipe qui partagent leurs opinions, remettent en question le statu quo et apportent des idées novatrices. Nous considérons ce poste comme un tremplin pour une longue carrière au sein de notre équipe de gestion de projets. Que votre objectif soit d’évoluer vers les ventes ou l’approvisionnement, vous collaborerez étroitement avec ces départements au quotidien, bâtissant ainsi les relations et les connaissances nécessaires pour faire avancer votre carrière. La satisfaction client est notre priorité. Lorsque nous réussissons, nos clients réussissent. Vous serez au cœur de cette aventure. Vos responsabilités Vous gérerez les cycles de commande dans SAP, traiterez les factures et assurerez l’intégrité des documents. Plus important encore, vous serez la personne qui identifie les écarts et les résout avant qu’ils ne deviennent des goulots d’étranglement Vous collaborerez avec les services du soutien technique, des achats, de la logistique et de la fabrication. Vous devrez faire preuve d’influence pour convaincre vos collègues d’adopter vos améliorations de processus. Nous évoluons dans un milieu stimulant où les priorités changent rapidement. Votre capacité à rester organisé(e) et responsable sera essentielle. Qui vous êtes Vous détenez un baccalauréat (en sciences ou en affaires) et possédez au moins 2 ans d’expérience en gestion de projets ou en milieu manufacturier. Vous êtes parfaitement bilingue (français et anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit). Vous apprenez rapidement, êtes organisé(e) et avez l’esprit d’équipe. Vous maîtrisez la suite Microsoft Office. Une expérience avec SAP est un atout majeur. Vous êtes fiable. Vous prenez vos responsabilités à cœur et votre équipe peut compter sur vous pour accomplir le travail avec rigueur, dès la première fois. Logistique Ce poste est basé à notre usine de Laprairie. Nous misons sur la collaboration en personne pour vous aider à réussir rapidement. Vous serez sur place 5 jours par semaine pendant les 4 à 6 premiers mois pour une intégration intensive, avec une transition vers un horaire de 4 jours sur place par la suite. Prêt(e) à grandir avec nous ? Si vous êtes une personne énergique, brillante et hautement organisée, cherchant à bâtir une carrière où vos idées ont un réel impact, nous voulons vous connaître. The Impact You’ll Make As an Order Management Specialist, you are the crucial link between the commercial teams, our Project Managers, and our Planning team. You won’t just be entering data; you’ll be the architect of project flow. By maintaining accuracy in SAP and ensuring our documentation and logistics are seamless, you set the stage for every milestone we hit. In your first six months, success will be measured by your ability to keep our internal and external deliverables on time, ensuring that we hit our milestones, and help track customer satisfaction. Why You’ll Love It Here A Culture of Ownership: We value team members who share their opinions, challenge the status quo, and bring fresh ideas to the table. We view this role as a launchpad to a long career in the project management team or even a goal is to move into Sales or procurement, you will be partnering closely with those departments every day, building the relationships and knowledge you need to advance your career. We are driven by customer satisfaction. When we succeed, our clients succeed. You will be at the center of that journey. What You’ll Do You will manage order cycles in SAP, handle invoices, and ensure document integrity—but more importantly, you’ll be the one to flag discrepancies and solve them before they become bottlenecks. You’ll collaborate across Technical Support, Purchasing, Logistics, and Manufacturing. You’ll need the influence to get others on board with your process improvements. We operate in a high-energy environment. You’ll be balancing tight deadlines and shifting priorities, so your ability to stay organized and accountable is vital. Who You Are You have a Bachelor’s degree (Science or Business) and at least 2 years of experience in project management or manufacturing. You are fluent in French and English (written and oral). You are a quick learner, well-organised and a team player. You are proficient with the Microsoft Office Suite. If you have SAP experience, that’s a huge plus. You are reliable. You take ownership of your tasks and your team relies on you to get things done right the first time. Logistics This role is based at our Laprairie plant. We value face-to-face collaboration to help you hit the ground running. You’ll be on-site 5 days a week for the first 4–6 months for intensive onboarding, transitioning to a 4-day on-site schedule thereafter. Ready to grow with us? If you are an energetic, bright, and highly organized professional who wants to build a career where your ideas make an impact, we want to hear from you. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

This role is based in Singapore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. To succeed in this position you must be fully fluent in English (spoken and written). Please note that your resume must be submitted in English, and the interview process will be conducted in English. 회사 소개
CPLB(Coupang Private Label Brands)는 고품질의 상품을 경쟁력 있는 가격에 제공함으로써 고객에게 최대 가치를 전달하고자 노력하는 조직입니다. 신선 식품 브랜드 곰곰, 가정 및 반려동물 용품 브랜드 탐사, 건강 및 미용 제품 브랜드 비타할로, 라이프 및 홈 브랜드 코멧을 포함한 프라이빗 브랜드의 상품은 고객들에게 가장 저렴한 가격과 최고의 서비스로 훌륭한 제품을 선택할 수 있는 상품 셀렉션을 제공합니다. CPLB는 고객을 위한 가격, 서비스 및 선택 사이의 가장 큰 균형을 깨기 위한 우리의 사명의 모범 사례입니다. 또한 CPLB는 고객 및 중소기업과 함께 더 큰 혜택을 공유하기 위해 양질의 중소기업 파트너와 계속 협력할 것입니다.
CPLB는 다양한 배경을 가진 전문가들로 구성된 역동적인 팀이며, Brand Managment, Instock Management, Technical Services, Program Management, 디자인, 품질 및 컴플라이언스, 재무 및 마케팅이 포함됩니다.
우리는 전문 지식을 활용하여 시장 동향과 통찰력을 따라 고객을 위한 관련 제품을 개발합니다. 우리는 재고 관리를 최적화하고 제품을 경쟁력 있는 가격으로 항상 사용할 수 있도록 하기 위해 가장 효율적인 공급망을 설계하기 위해 노력합니다. 우리는 고객을 위해 더 많은 제품을 개발하는 반면 기술과 자동화 시스템을 사용하여 내부 프로세스와 비즈니스 효율성을 지속적으로 향상시킵니다. 우리 팀은 우리의 모든 제품과 프로세스가 규제 요구 사항을 준수하도록 보장합니다.
CPLB에서는 자신만의 전문성을 살려 고객이 사랑하는 브랜드를 만들 수 있는 기회를 찾을 수 있습니다. 더 다양한 쿠팡의 자체 상품 셀렉션을 함께 만들어 가고 싶다면 CPLB와 함께하세요.

전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

사항
본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

반환 정책
본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (
recruitingops@coupang.com
) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.
